articles.abstract_en: We assess how investors’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for sustainable investments responds to the social impact of those investments, using a framed field experiment. While investors have a substantial WTP for sustainable investments, they do not pay significantly more for more impact. This also holds for dedicated impact investors. When investors compare several sustainable investments, their WTP responds to relative, but not to absolute, levels of impact. Regardless of investments’ impact, investors experience positive emotions when choosing sustainable investments. Our findings suggest that the WTP for sustainable investments is primarily driven by an emotional, rather than a calculative, valuation of impact.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个框架性实地实验，评估了投资者对可持续投资的支付意愿（WTP）如何响应这些投资的社会影响力。尽管投资者对可持续投资有显著的支付意愿，但他们并未为更大的影响力支付显著更多的费用。这一结论同样适用于专门的影响力投资者。当投资者比较多个可持续投资时，他们的支付意愿响应于相对影响力水平，而非绝对影响力水平。无论投资的影响力如何，投资者在选择可持续投资时都会体验到积极情绪。我们的研究结果表明，对可持续投资的支付意愿主要受情感而非计算性的影响力估值驱动。

articles.title_cn: 不忠的管理者与股东财富
articles.abstract_en: A duty of loyalty prohibits fiduciaries from appropriating business opportunities from their companies. Starting in 2000, Delaware, followed by several other states, allowed boards to waive their duty. We show that public firms covered by waiver laws invest less in R&D, produce fewer and less valuable patents, and exhibit abnormally high inventor departures. Remaining innovation activities contribute less to firm value, a fact confirmed by the market reaction when firms reveal their curtailed internal growth opportunities by announcing acquisitions. Consistent with the laws’ intent to provide contracting flexibility to emerging firms, we find evidence of positive impacts for small firms. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 忠诚义务禁止受托人从公司挪用商业机会。从2000年开始，特拉华州，随后其他几个州，允许董事会放弃这一义务。我们发现，受豁免法律覆盖的上市公司在研发上的投资减少，产生的专利数量更少且价值更低，并且发明人离职异常高。剩余的创新活动对公司价值的贡献减少，这一事实在市场对公司通过宣布收购来揭示其缩减的内部增长机会时的反应中得到证实。与法律旨在为新兴企业提供合同灵活性的意图一致，我们发现了对小企业积极影响的证据。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Do Cash Windfalls Affect Wages? Evidence from R&D Grants to Small Firms
articles.title_cn: 现金意外之财是否影响工资？来自小企业研发补助的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how employee earnings respond to a one-time cash flow shock in the form of a government R&D grant. In a regression discontinuity design, we find that the grant immediately increases average annual employee-level earnings by 2.9$\%$. This benefit accrues only to incumbent employees and rises with job tenure. The grant also affects firm growth, but the initial wage patterns do not appear to reflect growth or productivity. Instead, the evidence supports implicit equity financing within the firm, where employees initially accept lower wages from financially constrained firms and earn more when the firm has ability to pay. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了员工收入如何应对政府研发补助形式的一次性现金流冲击。在断点回归设计中，我们发现补助立即将员工年均收入提高了2.9。这一收益仅归属于在职员工，并随工作任期增加而上升。补助还影响企业增长，但初始工资模式似乎并未反映增长或生产率。相反，证据支持企业内部隐性股权融资，即员工最初接受来自财务受限企业的较低工资，并在企业有能力支付时获得更多收入。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁获取。

articles.title_en: Product Innovation and Credit Market Disruptions
articles.title_cn: 产品创新与信贷市场中断
articles.abstract_en: We provide new evidence that disruptions in firms’ access to credit during the Global Financial Crisis significantly affected product innovation in the consumer goods sector. We combine highly granular retail scan data with lending data and find that credit-constrained firms introduced fewer new products, those products were less novel, and new products sold less well. Overall, these findings suggest that disruptions to credit markets impair firms’ ability to compete for profits through new product offerings. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了新的证据，表明在全球金融危机期间，企业获得信贷的中断显著影响了消费品行业的产品创新。我们将高度细粒度的零售扫描数据与贷款数据相结合，发现受信贷约束的企业推出的新产品较少，这些产品的创新性较低，且新产品的销售表现较差。总体而言，这些发现表明，信贷市场的中断削弱了企业通过新产品供应来竞争利润的能力。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Intellectual Property Rights and Debt Financing
articles.abstract_en: I examine how the investment and financing of innovation are affected by the contractual allocation of intellectual property rights using a Federal Circuit ruling that strengthened firms’ property rights to employee patents. I find that treatment firms’ total debt-to-assets ratio and R&D spending increase by 18% and 9%, respectively, as the residual control over patents increases firms’ incentives to innovate. These effects are more pronounced when ex ante holdup exposure is high. Furthermore, I find a positive marginal effect of asset complementarity as it limits the decline in employee incentives. Consistently, I show that firms’ ex post asset complementarity improves. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了创新的投资和融资如何受到知识产权合同分配的影响，利用联邦巡回法院的一项裁决，该裁决加强了企业对员工专利的财产权。我发现，随着对专利的剩余控制权增加了企业的创新激励，处理组企业的总债务与资产比率和研发支出分别增加了18%和9%。这些效应在事前敲竹杠风险高时更为显著。此外，我发现资产互补性的边际效应为正，因为它限制了员工激励的下降。与此一致，我表明企业的事后资产互补性有所改善。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Rating Agency Fees: Pay to Play in Public Finance?
articles.title_cn: 评级机构费用：公共财政中的付费参与？
articles.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between credit rating levels and rating agency fees in a public finance market in which rating agencies earn lower fees and face higher disclosure requirements relative to corporate bond and structured finance markets. Controlling for variation in the complexity of credit analysis at the issue level, we find evidence that rating agency conflicts of interest distort credit ratings in the municipal bond market. Unexpectedly expensive ratings are more likely downgraded, and inexpensive ratings are more likely upgraded. The relationship between credit ratings and rating agency fees is driven by issuers who lose access to AAA insurance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在公共财政市场中信用评级水平与评级机构费用之间的关系，在该市场中，相对于公司债券和结构性融资市场，评级机构赚取较低的费用并面临更高的披露要求。在控制发行层面信用分析复杂性的变化后，我们发现有证据表明评级机构的利益冲突扭曲了市政债券市场的信用评级。出乎意料地昂贵的评级更可能被下调，而廉价的评级更可能被上调。信用评级与评级机构费用之间的关系是由失去AAA保险渠道的发行人驱动的。

articles.title_cn: 流动性恐慌下的宏观审慎政策
articles.abstract_en: We study the optimality of macroprudential policies in an environment where banks provide liquidity to firms. Informational frictions between banks can cause interbank market freezes, prompting firms to accumulate their own liquid assets. Liquidity hoarding by firms in turn reduces the demand for bank loans and bank profitability, makes interbank market freezes even more likely, and may ultimately trigger a self-fulfilling bad equilibrium. Such “liquidity panics” provide an additional rationale for liquidity requirements on banks, which alleviate frictions in the banking sector and, paradoxically, can increase aggregate investment. Instead, policies encouraging bank lending can have the opposite effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在银行向企业提供流动性的环境中宏观审慎政策的最优性。银行之间的信息摩擦可能导致银行间市场冻结，促使企业积累自己的流动资产。企业囤积流动性反过来减少了对银行贷款的需求和银行盈利能力，使银行间市场冻结更可能发生，并最终可能引发自我实现的坏均衡。这种“流动性恐慌”为银行流动性要求提供了额外的理由，这缓解了银行部门的摩擦，并且矛盾的是，可以增加总投资。相反，鼓励银行贷款的政策可能产生相反的效果。

articles.abstract_en: We characterize the unique equilibrium in an economy populated by strategic CARA investors who trade multiple risky assets with arbitrarily distributed payoffs. We use our explicit solution to study the joint behavior of illiquidity of option contracts. Option bid-ask spreads are proportional to risk aversion and risk-neutral variances of option payoffs. Spreads may decrease in risk aversion, physical variance, open interest, and increase after earnings announcements in a result contrary to conventional wisdom. All these predictions are confirmed empirically using a large panel data set of U.S. stock options. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了一个由战略性CARA投资者组成的经济体中的唯一均衡，这些投资者交易多种具有任意分布收益的风险资产。我们利用显式解来研究期权合约非流动性的联合行为。期权买卖价差与风险厌恶和期权收益的风险中性方差成比例。价差可能随风险厌恶、物理方差、未平仓合约减少，并在盈利公告后增加，这与传统观点相反。所有这些预测都通过美国股票期权的大面板数据集得到了实证确认。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。
